model_config.prefix_features: 60 clipped normalized summaries + 11 inner-train-threshold prefix-state indicators + 2 unclipped normalized log1p prefix moments
model_config.generator: shared latent mixture; separately predicted future initial-mask logits; per-block binary transition rows; per-channel zero-sum block contrast; per-channel scale; future level integrated out in projected contrast likelihood
model_config.loss: unchanged nine-query BCE +0.1 common path/mask auxiliary, then separate weighted conditional-fine SGD substep
model_config.stopping: fixed40epochs, checkpoint final; no held stopping; first numerical/timeout/integrity failure stops batch
model_config.source_folds: existing source34 people/1442 recordings,3folds; historically exposed exploratory
model_config.primary_score: participant-macro mean9query clipped log loss, include invalid15rows; same source folds/threshold provenance as prior baseline
model_config.promotion_screen: at least2percent lower primary score than strongest Markov/HGB baseline and improvement in at least2of3folds; exploratory only; all controls/failures reported
model_config.baseline_recheck: future runner must match saved source Markov/HGB evaluation with inner-train preprocessing before new comparative claims
model_config.path_label_normalization: inner-train pooled within-record contrast scale; no between-note level variance; future centering is labels only, never inference input
model_config.invariance_scope: auxiliary target likelihood conditional on fixed future mask is invariant to per-record per-channel constant shifts; not a claim of raw audio or network-input invariance
model_config.fine_optimizer: plain SGD, no momentum/decay/clipping; project actual displacement, fine head ordinary SGD
model_config.norm_matching: each arm own current null proposal norm; denominator or target exactly zero gives zero applied step
model_config.fine_bins: innertrain-valid octiles, quantile method linear, existing quartiles inserted at positions2/4/6, > counts, invalid64
model_config.fine_objective: conditional CE within true coarse fibre, no coarse/fine truth inference input
model_config.architecture: same encoder/generator/free_head initialization; identity bias-free linear32x32 adapter, fine linear32to65; common generator branches from encoder u

baseline_policy.hgb: reuse sealed source all_predictions, new fits0

baseline_policy.retrieval: reuse sealed four donor-arm source predictions, no refit

failure_policy: first job failure/timeout stops entire batch; preserve partialweights/predictions/receipts; no promotion of incomplete batch
evaluation: parent seals all12 predictions/weights/traces/stats/receipts before held event scoring; no in-training held scoring
fitting_authority: FREEZE.json execution_authorized=true plus active atomic job registration; embedded model_config false flags retain preparation provenance
budget_clock: parent child-process per-job watchdog and whole-worker SIGALRM; teardown grace2s is charged and cannot produce successful overbudget job
